title: APT check config (apt.json)
description: Optional per-repository config read by apt-check (bin/apt-check.mjs, installed shim .apt/bin/apt-check.mjs). DR-017. Design settings stay in apt-design.json.

level.description: warn reports findings and never fails. error fails when findings exceed baseline. Default warn.

baseline.description: Findings accepted while the repo cleans up. With level error, the check fails above it and asks for it to be lowered when findings fall below it. Default 0.

zones.description: Zone name -> folders, relative to the repo root. Default: each apps/<name> folder as zone <name>, packages as zone packages.

aliases.description: Zone name -> package names that resolve into the zone (merged with workspace package.json names).

forbid.description: Imports that are not allowed. Default: no app imports another app, and packages import no app.

presentational.description: Folders of presentational components where fetch() is not allowed. Default: apps/web/src/components and apps/web/components when present.
